description: Using the specified cutoff \(n(i)\) for \(Y_n=X_n\cap B_n\), one can choose coordinate tuples satisfying \(\theta_{n(i)}\). For every \(k\), their \(\varphi_k\)-truth set contains \(Y_{k+1}\), and the same tuple of representative classes satisfies every \(\varphi_k\) in the actual ultraproduct.
